lines.text: *Rumble*
Dorothy's transformed body collapses.
Through the fluttering white wings and debris,
Dorothy's dark form charges.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Dorothy...!
Snow White's Seven Dwarves begins gathering light.
She aims at the approaching Dorothy.
But even I can see the muzzle of her gun trembling.
When the light bursts from Seven Dwarves, it only grazes Dorothy's black wing.
*Pew! Pew! Pew!*
Dorothy's gun fires bursts of light.
Rapunzel jumps in front of Snow White and activates her shield.
Realizing her attacks have been blocked, Dorothy changes direction midair and circles around the shield to approach from behind.
There, Scarlet is crouched, poised to draw her sword.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Forgive me, but I shall not hold back.
Scarlet's sword flies from its sheath.
A flash arcs precisely toward Dorothy's neck.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Alas... I cannot cleave.
*Slash!*
The flash from Scarlet's blade only slices a few strands of Dorothy's hair.
*Pow!*
Dorothy spins in the air and lands a kick squarely on Scarlet's stomach.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Aye...! Thou art meant to fight with thy body...!
Scarlet goes flying into Snow White and Rapunzel, sending all three of them tumbling to the ground.
Dorothy once again charges at the three of them lying on the ground, aiming her gun at them.
Rapi activates her drill and attacks Dorothy from the flank.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Pierce through!
*Craaack*

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Urgh...!
Dorothy raises both arms and blocks Rapi's drill.
Sparks erupt as fragments go flying.
Keep up pressure! Pin her down and keep her from moving!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hrrrnnngh...!
Vroooooom!
The thrusters on Rapi's Seven Dwarves spew fire, pushing Dorothy back.
Dorothy is driven into the ground.
Rapi stands over her as she lies there.
Just as Rapi activates her drill again, preparing to thrust it toward Dorothy,
Dorothy kips up into a kick, catching Rapi on the chin.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You've got a gun, why aren't you shooting?!
Anis hits Dorothy from behind with a knockout kick.
As Dorothy loses her balance and starts to fall, Neon swings her gun toward her face.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Sorry about this!
*Baaaaam!*
Dorothy gets hit by Neon's gun and goes flying.
Rapi! Grab her and throw her!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger!
Before Dorothy can hit the ground, Rapi grabs her by the ankle and uses her momentum to fling her away.
With a resounding crash, Dorothy goes flying and slams into a boulder.
Focus fire!
Rapi, Anis, and Neon unleash a barrage of fire on Dorothy, who's lodged in the boulder.
Explosions and flames erupt, and debris flies in all directions.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: W-wait! That's a little overboard...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Dost thou mean to kill her?!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What are you talking about? This would hardly scratch even uncorrupted Dorothy!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Everyone, help us! We need to do as much damage as we can!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Tsk...! She's getting up!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Snow White. Fire.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Aaaagh!
*Booom!*
Snow White's Seven Dwarves spews fire.
The boulder Dorothy is embedded in crumbles to pieces.
Dorothy goes flying quite a distance before struggling to get back on her feet.
She strains to steady her trembling body as she lets out ragged breaths.
She's not using her self-repair.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: What...?
She's not using self-repair! She's a Heretic, but she's not using it!
It's not that she can't! She just won't!
Dorothy flies up into the air before charging toward us at low altitude.
However, she soon crashes to the ground and skids.
She struggles to get to her feet, then stumbles toward us.
She opens fire, but every one of her shots misses.
Deputy Chief Andersen walks up to Dorothy.
I walk alongside him.

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Ah... Ngh...
Dorothy aims her gun again.
She doesn't fire.
She barely manages to move her trembling arm to aim the gun again.
She points it at her own head.

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Comman...der...

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Your... Grace...

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Ra...pi... A...nis... Ne...on...

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Snow... White... Scar...let... Rapun... zel...

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Save... me...

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: Help... me...
I reach out to grab Dorothy's arm, pulling it away from her head.
... She doesn't seem to resist.
*Click*
Deputy Chief Andersen points his gun at Dorothy.
Is that a Vapaus round?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Yes. I got held up making this.
I'll add to that.
I reach out with my other hand and place it in front of the gun's muzzle.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Are you sure?
It'll heal on its own.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: How admirable.
Deputy Chief Andersen points his gun at Dorothy's head.
*Rattle, rattle*

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Hah... Just look at me.
His gun trembles.
Just then, Dorothy reaches out with her other hand.
She grips the trembling gun tightly.
The gun steadies.

lines.speaker: dorothy_h
lines.text: ... Are you... scared?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Lilith and I really do have an eye for talent.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Choosing you was the right decision, Dorothy.
*Bang!*
The Vapaus round pierces my hand and hits Dorothy in the head.
I don't feel any pain.
Deputy Chief Andersen and I take a step back and look at Dorothy's slumped form.
... She doesn't move.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Dorothy!
Rapunzel runs over and checks on her.
She closes her eyes and places a hand on Dorothy's head.
A golden glow emanates outward.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Everyone! Come over and talk to Dorothy!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: The corruption is too severe! It must be an enhanced version!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: At this rate, the Vapaus might destroy her NIMPH first, then the corruption!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Who she is when she comes back will be determined by whatever's left in her head—the Corruption or her NIMPH!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: We need to strengthen her NIMPH quickly! If we don't, she'll revert to her Heretic self!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Wh-what do you need us to do?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: We need to strengthen Dorothy's sense of self! Talk to her!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Dorothy!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... Dorothy.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I gave up on you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I was disappointed in you when you said you would no longer fight for humanity.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: So I gave up on you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You're determined in so many ways, I thought you'd never change your mind once you'd made a decision.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: My prediction was correct.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You've never once gone back on your decision.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I grew certain when I heard what he had to say about you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I was certain when you offered to lead the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You never once went back on your decision to fight for humanity.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You were always the same. I just never realized it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Instead of trying to sway you, I gave up on you.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... I didn't realize you've been struggling for so long.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: You've been agonizing and second-guessing yourself all this time.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: And in the midst of that, we turned our backs on you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'm sorry we weren't there to make those decisions with you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'm sorry we weren't there to share your doubts.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'm sorry we never listened to or understood you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: So please, come back to us.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Come back and accept our apologies.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... In hindsight, 'twas you who lifted us from our despair.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Twas you who stood us upon our feet, though we were blinded by our mission, clouded with drink, and consumed with death.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I looked upon thee and found thee truly admirable.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Yet I was blind to it.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I was blind to thy need for someone to lean upon.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: For thou didst seem perfect.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Alas, I see... Thou wast not perfect.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: This time, we shall save thee.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: As thy comrades, we shall save thee.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Arise, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You're the Dorothy I knew back then,

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: the Dorothy who stood with us in our brightest moments.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I was wrong. We were wrong.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I want to hear you say we were wrong.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I want to hear it from your own lips.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Answer me, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Are you the Goddess of Victory?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Are you the hope of humanity?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Are you a Goddess?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Answer me, Dorothy!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Who art thou?!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Tell us, Dorothy! Say it with your own lips!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Answer us! Dorothy!!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: am a Goddess of Victory.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: The hope of humanity.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: The leader of the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I am Dorothy.
Light spreads from Dorothy.
It pierces her ominous black armor,
and white wings begin to unfurl.
Surrounded by her dazzling white wings,
the Goddess of Victory
casts aside all despair and hesitation
and lands on the ground.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... Incredible.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Everyone.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I'm sorry it took such a long time.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: for waiting and believing in me.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Pray, who art thou?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Dorothy would never utter words of apology or gratitude. Who art thou?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: You can't be serious.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... I heard.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I heard everything all of you said.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: So... you don't have to say anything more.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... We heard everything too.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: We saw and heard everything, too.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Thank you for coming back to us.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I'm so glad we're fighting alongside each other again.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Me too.
Dorothy looks at me.
Then her gaze shifts to Rapi, Anis, and Neon.
She nods slightly.
We all nod back.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Don't give me a hard time.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Then you shouldn't have worked me so hard.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Still, I kept my promise. I said I'd find you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I'm glad you're back.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: It's time to get back to work. Especially since you've powered up. Don't you think?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Fine. I'll humor you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Burningum.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Did you see?

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: ... Yes, I saw all right.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Now then.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Let us begin...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: the Third Surface Reclamation War.
Inside the Central Government's main conference room in the Ark...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: What's wrong? You seem dazed.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Oh, right. Sorry.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Status report, if you please.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There's been a small problem, but nothing we can't handle..

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Preparations are complete.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No updates from me. We're all set.

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: We are préparés.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Ark's ascent sequence is ready.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We can initiate it at any time.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... All right. What's left?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We can proceed after removing all obstructions above and around the gate.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Good. Everyone get ready.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It won't take long to clear things up there.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You have a lot of faith in them.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That goes without saying.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I'll leave the area near the gate to you and Counters.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: We'll stay here and stop any more Raptures from approaching the Ark.
With only this many people...?
As soon as I say that, I realize I've misspoken.
Snow White.
Scarlet.
Rapunzel.
Dorothy.
And their Commander.
For some reason, I feel invigorated.
With them, I feel like there's nothing we can't accomplish.
Understood. We'll head toward the Ark's gate.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Good. Let's get this taken care of and go take the Queen's head together.
Yes. Let's go, everyone.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: See you guys in a bit.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: May our firepower guide us until we meet again.
... Deputy Chief.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Yes?
I'd like to have a proper talk with you later.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Oh, my. Having too many fans can be quite a burden.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: For you, I have all the time in the world.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: What are you acting so proud for?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Don't you think you sound a little strange whenever you talk to Believer?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Well, get going.. The longer I'm around you, the more my dignity suffers.
I nod and head off.
We sprint toward the Ark's gate.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Calling that a legendary return feels trite, but...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I mean, I can't think of anything else to call it.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I have a feeling.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I think we're gonna crush this fight.
Wow. I feel the same way.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Then let's go win.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We've been winning so much lately that I'm almost getting bored of it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What are you talking about? You lost to me.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: D-don't get cocky. You can't call that a win when you tricked me.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Master, are you sure nothing happened with Rapi?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow, Anis suddenly getting all quiet and focused is really weird.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I-I was just thinking about the fight.
... Like I told you, nothing happened.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I mean, I thought as much, but that's such a dull ending.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Something did happen. Maybe a 0.3?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I have no idea what unit of measurement you're using, but that's basically the same as saying nothing happened.
Girls, this is the final battle. Let's take this a little more seriously.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Enough with the silly comments, all of you.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You started it!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: When will you girls finally grow up?
We race onto the battlefield near the Ark's gate.
Andersen, Dorothy, Snow White, Scarlet, and Rapunzel are staring straight ahead.
Countless Raptures are swarming toward them.
Raptures, an enemy they've faced countless times before.
A fearsome presence they have constantly risked their lives to fight against.
But now...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: No need to worry about the Ark gate. The Ark's elite forces will handle that.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Our job is simple: keep any of them from getting past us.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Now, you probably have a lot to say or questions to ask.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Set them aside for now. Focus on the enemy in front of you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: The Ark's ascent is a once-in-a-lifetime event. Let's not screw this up.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Now then.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Begin, Dorothy.
Andersen looks at Dorothy.
Dorothy stares at Andersen in a daze for a moment before turning away.
Snow White looks at Dorothy and nods.
With a slight smile, Scarlet adjusts her grip on her sword.
Rapunzel smiles and waves for her to go on.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... Is it really okay if I lead?
Everyone nods.
Dorothy looks ahead.
She slowly walks forward,
standing in front of everyone.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: *Huff...*

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Visual confirmation on Raptures, heading into firing range soon.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I stand prepared.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Ready when you are.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: We have to protect the Ark at all costs.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Humanity's future lies in our hands.
Dorothy's lips quiver.
How dearly she must've missed this. How badly she must've longed to say it.
She'd repeated these words to herself hundreds, even thousands of times,
but she was never able to say them.
The words that symbolized the brightest days of her life.
The words she's finally able to say.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Goddess Squad, ready.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Encounter!
